{{Otheruses|Combine}}
The '''Vacutech Combine''' was a small company that specialized in the production of personal defense weapons. During the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the company came under severe scrutiny after not keeping an accurate record of who it was selling to. As a result, the Imperial bureaucracy forced the small company out of business. The remaining assets of Vacutech were later purchased by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]].<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>
